featured_reviews.name: AMIT V
featured_reviews.review_text:
Good place with decent facilities. I have been visiting here frequently. It’s great if you are a small start up or a team operating remotely. They do provide ample space. As much as I value dfactory, there are few improvements required. I will definitely mention that it is not very quiet here, if you are sitting in an open space. The front office staff needs to be a bit more mannered, often they get into arguments among themselves which makes the decorum non-conducive to calls. WiFi breakage is frequent, but largely works fine. They do a good job of cleaning and sanitizing, but sometimes i feel toilets needs to better managed.

Will recommend it to everyone in Vasai, overall i enjoy coming here.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Hey Amit V

thank you for your rating. We are delighted to hear that you had a positive experience with us.                                 We hope to see you soon and thank you once again

Regards
Team Dfactory
